    private static bool IsSerializationConflict(global::System.Exception? ex)

    /// <summary>

    private static bool IsWellFormedMediaType(string? value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return false;
        var parts = value!.Split(';')[0].Trim().Split('/');
